failure: Failure: A violation does not falsify Newtonian gravity: the pair can be unbound or perturbed, or masses, velocities or astrometry can be wrong; an unseen companion can alter the model. The result reproduces a known observational issue and is not a new anomaly.
interface: Interface: The inequality is conditional on the adopted central astrometry, radial velocities, component masses, exact perspective reconstruction and isolated two-body Newtonian model. It is a feasibility envelope over unknown depth, not a probabilistic orbit fit or a gravity test.

claims.title: A cubic envelope minimizes wide-binary binding energy over unknown line-of-sight depth
